title: Add mouse actions for Present Windows and Desktop Grid
line: The desktop's Mouse Actions settings have a new Overview action that opens Overview, Grid View or the window view when you click.
explanation: The desktop's mouse actions only offered Paste, Application Launcher, Standard Menu and switching desktops, windows or activities. KWin's Overview, Grid View and Window View (the successors of Desktop Grid and Present Windows) live in KWin, so the shell had no way to open them from a click. The change adds an Overview containment action plugin that invokes the chosen KWin global shortcut (Overview, Grid View, Expose or ExposeAll) through kglobalaccel's invokeShortcut, like KRunner's shortcut runner does; its configuration dialog picks which one.

commits.message:
containmentactions: add an Overview mouse action

There was no way to open KWin's Overview or window grid by clicking on
the desktop. This adds a mouse action that invokes KWin's Overview, Grid
View or Window View shortcut, chosen in its configuration dialog.

BUG: 392741

diff --git a/containmentactions/overview/overview.cpp b/containmentactions/overview/overview.cpp

--- /dev/null
+++ b/containmentactions/overview/overview.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "overview.h"
+
+#include <KConfigGroup>
+#include <KLocalizedString>
+#include <KPluginFactory>
+
+#include <QAction>
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+#include <QDBusMessage>
+
+using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;
+
+Overview::Overview(QObject *parent, const QVariantList &args)
+    : Plasma::ContainmentActions(parent, args)
+    , m_action(new QAction(this))
+    , m_shortcut(u"Overview"_s)
+{
+    connect(m_action, &QAction::triggered, this, &Overview::invoke);
+}
+
+void Overview::restore(const KConfigGroup &config)
+{
+    m_shortcut = config.readEntry("shortcut", u"Overview"_s);
+}
+
+QWidget *Overview::createConfigurationInterface(QWidget *parent)
+{
+    auto *widget = new QWidget(parent);
+    m_ui.setupUi(widget);
+    widget->setWindowTitle(i18nc("@title:window", "Configure Overview Plugin"));
+    if (m_shortcut == u"Grid View") {
+        m_ui.gridButton->setChecked(true);
+    } else if (m_shortcut == u"Expose") {
+        m_ui.windowsButton->setChecked(true);
+    } else if (m_shortcut == u"ExposeAll") {
+        m_ui.allWindowsButton->setChecked(true);
+    } else {
+        m_ui.overviewButton->setChecked(true);
+    }
+    return widget;
+}
+
+void Overview::configurationAccepted()
+{
+    if (m_ui.gridButton->isChecked()) {
+        m_shortcut = u"Grid View"_s;
+    } else if (m_ui.windowsButton->isChecked()) {
+        m_shortcut = u"Expose"_s;
+    } else if (m_ui.allWindowsButton->isChecked()) {
+        m_shortcut = u"ExposeAll"_s;
+    } else {
+        m_shortcut = u"Overview"_s;
+    }
+}
+
+void Overview::save(KConfigGroup &config)
+{
+    config.writeEntry("shortcut", m_shortcut);
+}
+
+QList<QAction *> Overview::contextualActions()
+{
+    return {m_action};
+}
+
+void Overview::invoke()
+{
+    QDBusMessage msg =
+        QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(u"org.kde.kglobalaccel"_s, u"/component/kwin"_s, u"org.kde.kglobalaccel.Component"_s, u"invokeShortcut"_s);
+    msg << m_shortcut;
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().call(msg, QDBus::NoBlock);
+}
+
+K_PLUGIN_CLASS_WITH_JSON(Overview, "plasma-containmentactions-overview.json")
+
+#include "overview.moc"
+
+#include "moc_overview.cpp"

+    Q_OBJECT
+public:
+    explicit Overview(QObject *parent, const QVariantList &args);
+
+    void restore(const KConfigGroup &config) override;
+    QWidget *createConfigurationInterface(QWidget *parent) override;
+    void configurationAccepted() override;
+    void save(KConfigGroup &config) override;
+
+    QList<QAction *> contextualActions() override;
+
+private:

+
+    QAction *const m_action;
+    Ui::Config m_ui;
+    QString m_shortcut;
+};
